author: SUPUZZ Editorial Team
title: Bring ocean, ice and forest together in one imaginative world
description: Try SUPUZZ nature-themed building play: combine scenes, invent stories and share ideas while checking the connections of your selected sets.
imageAlt: SUPUZZ ocean, ice and forest pieces arranged in a mixed scene

hero.caption: A mixed-series play example. Additional sets are sold separately.

intro: A tree full of fish or an icy garden beneath the sea: an imaginary scene does not have to follow the real world. Start with a child’s idea and build a story around it.

connections.title: Start with connections that fit
paragraphs: SUPUZZ ocean, ice and forest collections include compatible nature-series connectors. Rearrange bases, stems and decorations to imagine another landscape. Not every SUPUZZ product or piece uses the same system; check the selected set and never force a connection.

ideas.title: Three scenes to try
paragraphs: Let children name the place and decide who lives there.
items: An ocean forest: imagine coral and branches as trees where fish live.
An icy garden: arrange winter decorations, flowers and creatures on blue bases.
A path between worlds: put ocean and ice scenes side by side and invent a journey.

questions.title: Ask a question that opens a story
paragraphs: Who lives here? Where did that fish come from? Ask about the idea before correcting a shape. A story question gives children room to explain and add something new.

together.title: Find a role for everyone
paragraphs: One person arranges the ground, another chooses decorations and another names the characters. Build one shared scene or connect separate small worlds at the end.

start.title: Explore what you already have
paragraphs: You do not need several sets to begin. Reimagining a familiar piece can change the game. Before adding another set, check its contents and connection examples.

items.question: Do nature-series pieces connect directly to waffle blocks?
items.answer: The systems differ. Check each product’s instructions; separate builds can still share a story side by side.

items.question: Must we follow an example?
items.answer: No. Follow the product instructions for use while inventing your own arrangement. Do not force pieces that do not fit.
